info.title: Zankai community profiles and replays
info.description: Server contract for the profile/replay UI. No UI or automatic client uploads are implemented by this backend change. Submit score summaries using the existing /scores endpoint, then fetch your top plays and PUT gzip-compressed local .stkr v5 files only for entries with replay.eligible=true and replay.available=false. Preserve local files on any error. Do not resubmit all scores on every profile view. Profile/download reads never contact osu!. These are self-reported scores, not server-verified replay results.

get.summary: Read current generation, whitelist and replay limits

200.description: Existing policy fields plus replays.enabled and the numeric limits from REPLAY_POLICY. Clients must read these rather than hardcoding the retention cap.

get.summary: Open a community leaderboard player's top plays
get.description: Public read. Current-generation eligible NM PBs only; sorted by pp descending, playedAt ascending, then beatmapId ascending. At most the top 100 scores are exposed. Banned/unknown players return 404. Map names may be null or empty until refreshed during a submission; fall back to beatmap ID/link, not extra osu! API requests.

put.summary: Attach a recording to your own accepted top play
put.description: Currently Sticks only. Binary gzip(.stkr v5), not .osr, JSON or base64. Do NOT set Content-Encoding:gzip; set Content-Type:application/gzip. The server validates size, decompression, frame structure, timestamps, finite stick values, buttons and activation threshold, but does not re-simulate gameplay or verify pp. Recordings spanning more than replays.maxDurationSeconds from first to last frame get 413; check the duration before uploading, because rejected attempts still count toward upload allowances. An already-stored recording is immutable; repeat PUT returns 200 without another upload charge. 201 means newly stored.

409.description: Score changed, left retention, or another upload/cleanup is in progress. Refresh top plays; retry only if still eligible. Honor Retry-After when present.

507.description: Global replay storage budget full. Keep score/local replay; do not loop retries. Requires owner action or storage cleanup.

get.summary: Download another player's replay for local preservation/playback
get.description: Public download; no account login required. Available only while the source score is eligible, retained and unbanned. A saved .zkr is self-contained and does not expire when its remote copy is removed. This is a Zankai replay container, NOT an osu! .osr; the client must implement the decoder below and local playback/import. Never overwrite the downloader's score history with another player's score.

X-Replay-SHA256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the complete downloaded container

session.description: Existing Zankai session token from /auth/complete. Never send the osu! access token.

error.description: Safe user-facing error; local scores/replays remain valid

limited.description: Defer until Retry-After, then retry with backoff/jitter. Do not mark a score/replay permanently failed or discard it.

judgements.description: Sticks: timing Great/Ok/Meh/Miss, angle Great/Ok/Meh/Miss, click/slice Great/Ok/Meh/Miss, tracking hit/miss, tail hit/miss. Counts do not retain the per-note pairing needed to reconstruct 300/200/175/100/75.

missCount.description: Sticks note/head + click/slice misses. Timing and angle misses on a head are counted once, not twice. Excludes tracking and tail misses, which are returned separately. Other rulesets without a declared layout return null.

downloadPath.description: Relative to this service origin. Validate origin before sending credentials; public download needs none.
Present on newly created uploads; idempotent responses may omit it.

metadata.score: Play schema, without replay; rank and weightedPp are null

decoderRequirements: Bound the complete download to the advertised compressed limit plus 16 KiB of metadata; enforce a local hard maximum even if the service advertises more.
Validate magic, metadata length (at most 16 KiB), version, ruleset, map checksum and score identity.
Verify whole-file SHA-256 when supplied, then the embedded recording SHA-256.
Limit inflation to maxRawBytes while streaming; do not trust gzip ISIZE or metadata.rawBytes as allocation limits.
Load the original standard beatmap matching sourceMd5, convert with the supported Sticks generation, and restore the recorded activation threshold.
Import the recording into a separate downloaded-replay location; preserve its original player ID and do not add it to the downloader's submitted scores.
A saved file can be played without the community server, provided the client supports its format/conversion and has the matching beatmap.

notes: Fixed hour/day windows start with the first counted request, not midnight. Honor Retry-After.
Upload attempts consume count/byte allowances even if later validation or storage fails. Already-stored idempotent uploads bypass upload counters but not edge limits.
The global replay-attempt counter runs after bounded body reading and before decompression. Invalid auth/ownership/headers and over-limit bodies do not consume that counter.
IP shields can affect users sharing a network. They are approximate, not globally exact accounting or protection against every distributed attack.
Retention is top N eligible scores, not the N highest scores that happen to have replays; lower scores do not fill missing recording slots.
Budget-full errors block new replay storage, not score submissions or downloads.
R2 cleanup is retried every five minutes; retention changes deny reads immediately, with queued physical deletion. Local downloads are unaffected.
These budgets do not guarantee the account cannot exceed all free CPU/database/request/log quotas.
